title: Release F0 (deploy tooling only): tag every image with its git commit; deploys select by that tag, never by newest-pushed. No app code, no AWS changes.
why: 2026-10-07 near miss: CodeBuild project cruddur-backend-flask-bake-image (own GitHub PR webhook, now deleted) pushed a debug-mode dev image (28101cf4, tagged latest) to backend-flask 28 minutes after the real build (9ce1a1f2). The deploy procedure picked the most recently pushed image, so the next backend deploy would have pinned the debug image. F0 removes the newest-pushed selection entirely.
protocol: Kiro Supervised. Kiro replaces the 2 files in scope with the FULL content given in edits[], using the IDE write tool. Keep the executable bit (both files are mode 100755 in git). Read-only git (GIT_PAGER=cat) and the gate commands below only. C runs every mutating git, AWS and docker command. No cwd parameter; every command starts with an absolute cd. Run commands one at a time.

editing any file not in scope

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Build the production backend image and push it to ECR, tagged with the git
# commit it was built from.
#
# Release F0 (deploy safety): deploys select an image BY THIS COMMIT TAG, never
# by "most recently pushed". On 2026-10-07 a CodeBuild PR webhook pushed a
# debug-mode dev image 28 minutes after the real build; a newest-pushed lookup
# would have deployed it. The webhook is deleted, and the commit tag makes any
# stray push impossible to select.
#
# ':latest' is no longer pushed. In ECR it is ambiguous (it still points at that
# stray CodeBuild image), and no deploy uses it: the stacks pin @sha256 digests
# (the ':latest' mentions under aws/cfn are documentation examples only). The
# LOCAL 'backend-flask' tag is kept because bin/backend/run uses it.

ABS_PATH=$(readlink -f "$0")
BACKEND_PATH=$(dirname "$ABS_PATH")
BIN_PATH=$(dirname "$BACKEND_PATH")
PROJECT_PATH=$(dirname "$BIN_PATH")
BACKEND_FLASK_PATH="$PROJECT_PATH/backend-flask"

AWS_ACCOUNT_ID="931637612335"
AWS_REGION="us-east-1"
REPO="backend-flask"
REGISTRY="$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID.dkr.ecr.$AWS_REGION.amazonaws.com"
ECR_URL="$REGISTRY/$REPO"

# The commit tag only means something if the build context IS that commit.
# Refuse when anything under backend-flask/ differs from HEAD, including
# untracked files (Dockerfile.prod copies the whole folder). Ignored files such
# as __pycache__ are excluded by backend-flask/.gitignore and .dockerignore.
DIRTY=$(git -C "$PROJECT_PATH" status --porcelain -- backend-flask)
if [ -n "$DIRTY" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: backend-flask/ has uncommitted changes. Commit first, then build:" >&2
  echo "$DIRTY" >&2
  exit 1
fi

GIT_SHA=$(git -C "$PROJECT_PATH" rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)
DATE_TAG=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)

echo "== Building $REPO from commit $GIT_SHA"
docker build \
  -f "$BACKEND_FLASK_PATH/Dockerfile.prod" \
  -t "$REPO" \
  -t "$REPO:$GIT_SHA" \
  "$BACKEND_FLASK_PATH/."

echo "== Logging in to ECR"
aws ecr get-login-password --region "$AWS_REGION" | \
  docker login --username AWS --password-stdin "$REGISTRY"

echo "== Tagging and pushing $ECR_URL:$GIT_SHA (and :$DATE_TAG)"
docker tag "$REPO:$GIT_SHA" "$ECR_URL:$GIT_SHA"
docker tag "$REPO:$GIT_SHA" "$ECR_URL:$DATE_TAG"
docker push "$ECR_URL:$GIT_SHA"
docker push "$ECR_URL:$DATE_TAG"

# Resolve the digest FOR THIS COMMIT'S TAG, and refuse anything that is not a
# well-formed digest (a placeholder or an empty value once caused a rollback).
DIGEST=$(aws ecr describe-images \
  --repository-name "$REPO" \
  --region "$AWS_REGION" \
  --image-ids imageTag="$GIT_SHA" \
  --query 'imageDetails[0].imageDigest' \
  --output text)
if ! [[ "$DIGEST" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: could not resolve a valid digest for $REPO:$GIT_SHA (got: $DIGEST)" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo "== Backend build complete"
echo "   Commit: $GIT_SHA"
echo "   Digest: $DIGEST"
echo "   Pin in aws/cfn/service/config.toml:"
echo "   EcrImage = '$ECR_URL@$DIGEST'"
echo ""
echo "Next: pin that digest, then ./bin/cfn/service-deploy. Do NOT use"
echo "bin/ecs/deploy-backend (deleted in 50f33c6: it hardcoded the default VPC"
echo "and overwrote the fentoncruddur.com DNS records)."

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Build the production frontend image and push it to ECR, tagged with the git
# commit it was built from.
#
# Release F0 (deploy safety): deploys select an image BY THIS COMMIT TAG, never
# by "most recently pushed" (see bin/backend/build for the 2026-10-07 near
# miss). ':latest' is no longer pushed; no deploy uses it (the stacks pin
# @sha256 digests; ':latest' under aws/cfn appears only in doc examples).
#
# Paths are now absolute, so this script works from any directory (it used to
# require being run from the repo root).

ABS_PATH=$(readlink -f "$0")
FRONTEND_BIN_PATH=$(dirname "$ABS_PATH")
BIN_PATH=$(dirname "$FRONTEND_BIN_PATH")
PROJECT_PATH=$(dirname "$BIN_PATH")
FRONTEND_PATH="$PROJECT_PATH/frontend-react-js"

AWS_ACCOUNT_ID="931637612335"
AWS_REGION="us-east-1"
REPO="frontend-react-js"
REGISTRY="$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID.dkr.ecr.$AWS_REGION.amazonaws.com"
ECR_URL="$REGISTRY/$REPO"

# ========================================
# BUILD VALUES (public: they ship to every browser)
# ========================================
BACKEND_URL="https://api.fentoncruddur.com"
USER_POOL_ID="us-east-1_wAg3Cr3Px"
CLIENT_ID="12va2n69rq2of98ivm60b9625v"
# Audit HIGH-07: without this build-arg the bundle bakes "undefined" into the
# avatar upload URL (ProfileForm.js).
API_GATEWAY_URL="https://rtvb6kbife.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com"

# An empty REACT_APP_* value does not fail the build; it silently produces a
# broken bundle. Refuse to build instead.
for v in BACKEND_URL AWS_REGION USER_POOL_ID CLIENT_ID API_GATEWAY_URL; do
  if [ -z "${!v}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: required build value ${v} is empty. Aborting." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

# The commit tag only means something if the build context IS that commit.
# Refuse when anything under frontend-react-js/ differs from HEAD, including
# untracked files. node_modules/ and build/ are ignored by .gitignore.
DIRTY=$(git -C "$PROJECT_PATH" status --porcelain -- frontend-react-js)
if [ -n "$DIRTY" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: frontend-react-js/ has uncommitted changes. Commit first, then build:" >&2
  echo "$DIRTY" >&2
  exit 1
fi

GIT_SHA=$(git -C "$PROJECT_PATH" rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)
DATE_TAG=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)

echo "== Building $REPO from commit $GIT_SHA (backend URL: $BACKEND_URL)"
docker build \
  --build-arg REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL="$BACKEND_URL" \
  --build-arg REACT_APP_AWS_PROJECT_REGION="$AWS_REGION" \
  --build-arg REACT_APP_AWS_COGNITO_REGION="$AWS_REGION" \
  --build-arg REACT_APP_AWS_USER_POOLS_ID="$USER_POOL_ID" \
  --build-arg REACT_APP_CLIENT_ID="$CLIENT_ID" \
  --build-arg REACT_APP_API_GATEWAY_ENDPOINT_URL="$API_GATEWAY_URL" \
  -f "$FRONTEND_PATH/Dockerfile.prod" \
  -t "$REPO" \
  -t "$REPO:$GIT_SHA" \
  "$FRONTEND_PATH/."

echo "== Logging in to ECR"
aws ecr get-login-password --region "$AWS_REGION" | \
  docker login --username AWS --password-stdin "$REGISTRY"

echo "== Tagging and pushing $ECR_URL:$GIT_SHA (and :$DATE_TAG)"
docker tag "$REPO:$GIT_SHA" "$ECR_URL:$GIT_SHA"
docker tag "$REPO:$GIT_SHA" "$ECR_URL:$DATE_TAG"
docker push "$ECR_URL:$GIT_SHA"
docker push "$ECR_URL:$DATE_TAG"

# Resolve the digest FOR THIS COMMIT'S TAG and refuse anything malformed.
DIGEST=$(aws ecr describe-images \
  --repository-name "$REPO" \
  --region "$AWS_REGION" \
  --image-ids imageTag="$GIT_SHA" \
  --query 'imageDetails[0].imageDigest' \
  --output text)
if ! [[ "$DIGEST" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: could not resolve a valid digest for $REPO:$GIT_SHA (got: $DIGEST)" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo "== Frontend build complete"
echo "   Commit: $GIT_SHA"
echo "   Digest: $DIGEST"
echo "   Pin in aws/cfn/frontend/config.toml:"
echo "   EcrImage = '$ECR_URL@$DIGEST'"
echo ""
echo "Next: pin that digest, then ./bin/cfn/frontend-deploy."

new_deploy_procedure.replaces: the sort_by(imageDetails,&imagePushedAt)[-1] lookup in all earlier specs and the handoff
new_deploy_procedure.backend:
cd ~/aws-bootcamp-cruddur-2023
./bin/backend/build    # must be run on a committed tree; prints Commit and Digest
REPO=backend-flask; CFG=aws/cfn/service/config.toml
SHA=$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)
NEW=$(aws ecr describe-images --repository-name $REPO --image-ids imageTag=$SHA --query 'imageDetails[0].imageDigest' --output text)
echo "$SHA $NEW"    # CHECK: same digest the build printed
grep -n EcrImage $CFG
sed -i "s|$REPO@sha256:[^']*'|$REPO@$NEW'|" $CFG
grep -n EcrImage $CFG
./bin/cfn/service-deploy
new_deploy_procedure.why_safe: An image can only be selected if it carries the tag of the commit you are standing on, and the build refuses to run unless that commit is exactly what is in the folder. A stray push from anywhere else can never match.
